after.description: The Roborock Qrevo Master combines 10,000 Pa HyperForce suction with a DuoRoller Riser dual-rubber brush, an extending FlexiArm side brush and edge mop, dual mops spinning at up to 200 RPM with 30 water-flow settings, and 10 mm mop lifting. Multifunctional Dock 3.0 washes the mops with 60 C hot water, dries them with 45 C air, uses rotating scrapers to clean its base, refills the robot and empties dust for up to seven weeks between manual emptying. Reactive AI uses structured light and an RGB camera to recognize 62 object types in 20 categories; PreciSense LiDAR navigation and the built-in Hello Rocky voice assistant support cleaning control. The robot measures 350 x 353 x 103 mm and the dock 340 x 487 x 521 mm. The overview does not publish price, mass, battery capacity, runtime, charging time, tank capacity or IP rating. Suction, recognition and maintenance intervals are manufacturer claims, not independent test results.

The robot measures 13.78 x 13.78 x 3.84 in (about 350 x 350 x 97.5 mm) with the LDS retracted and 4.72 in (120 mm) with it lifted, and weighs 12.79 lbs (about 5.8 kg); the base station measures 16.54 x 17.32 x 19.88 in and weighs 24.47 lbs (about 11.1 kg). A 6,400 mAh battery serves a 220 ml dust box, 100 ml clean and 140 ml used water boxes, and 4 L clean plus 3.5 L used station tanks; the dock washes the roller at up to 100 C, dries the mop pads in about four hours and empties dust into a 3.2 L bag for up to 100 days. The page lists 899.99 USD against a 1,599.99 USD regular price and publishes only top-up runs of about 48, 37 and 20 min at low, medium and high water levels, and no full-charge runtime, charging time, dB rating, payload, travel speed, cleaning width, hourly area rate, IP rating or minimum aisle width. highlights: The Dreame Aqua10 Ultra Roller continuously rinses its FluffRoll roller mop with fresh water while the AutoSeal roller guard lifts it 0.55 in on carpets.
Up to 30,000 Pa Vormax suction lifts heavy debris, and ProLeap retractable legs cross obstacles up to 3.15 in.
OmniSight 2.0 pairs two AI cameras with a retracting LDS to avoid 240+ object types, including cables as thin as 0.04 in.
The dock washes the roller at up to 100 C, dries the mop pads in about four hours and empties dust into a 3.2 L bag for up to 100 days.
The page lists 899.99 USD against a 1,599.99 USD regular price and publishes no full-charge runtime, charging time or IP rating.

Ultrasonic carpet detection avoids carpets while mopping and boosts suction while vacuuming, and LiDAR mapping stores up to 3 floor plans.
